related.title: Rigetti 模組連接：多段傳輸損耗預算
related.titleEn: Rigetti modular links: cascaded transfer-loss budget
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付條件Ramsey差分、相位預算與多鄰居待測矩陣。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver differential Ramsey data, phase budget and a multi-neighbor test matrix. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Rigetti 模組連接：多段傳輸損耗預算』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付分段乘積／對數帳、介面診斷樹與相干測試缺口。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Rigetti modular links: cascaded transfer-loss budget', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver product/log loss accounting, an interface fault tree and missing coherence tests.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：用條件頻移ζ的累積相位φ=2πζt；此處ζ是Hz而非rad/s，結果以rad表示。 使用合成殘留ζ=20 kHz，待機t=1 μs；不假設廠商實際數值。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*pi*20e3*1e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：比較鄰居準備|0⟩與|1⟩的Ramsey相位差，並用0.5/1 μs兩窗檢查線性。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：獨立損失的生存概率相乘η總=η1η2η3；只計人口損失，不把它當完整量子通道保真度。 使用合成發送η1=0.98、線路η2=0.97、接收η3=0.98。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.98*0.97*0.98，另開一欄執行獨立核對：用−lnη把各段損失改為相加，再取exp還原；確認沒有將概率直接相加。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Accumulate phase φ=2πζt for conditional frequency shift ζ; ζ is Hz, not rad/s, and phase is rad. Use Synthetic residual ζ=20 kHz and idle t=1 μs; these are not vendor values. Evaluate nominal expression 2*pi*20e3*1e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compare Ramsey phase for neighboring |0⟩ and |1⟩ states and test linearity with0.5/1 μs windows.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Independent survival factors multiply ηtotal=η1η2η3; population survival is not full quantum-channel fidelity. Use Synthetic launchη1=0.98, lineη2=0.97 and receiveη3=0.98. Evaluate nominal expression 0.98*0.97*0.98 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Convert each loss using−lnη, add and exponentiate back; verify probabilities were not added directly.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Bluefors 控制線：低溫衰減器的噪聲折衷
related.titleEn: Bluefors control line: cryogenic attenuation and noise tradeoff
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付條件Ramsey差分、相位預算與多鄰居待測矩陣。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

Outcome: Deliver dB/power conversions, limiting-case tests and a thermalization-node diagram.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：用條件頻移ζ的累積相位φ=2πζt；此處ζ是Hz而非rad/s，結果以rad表示。 使用合成殘留ζ=20 kHz，待機t=1 μs；不假設廠商實際數值。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*pi*20e3*1e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：比較鄰居準備|0⟩與|1⟩的Ramsey相位差，並用0.5/1 μs兩窗檢查線性。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學經典噪聲溫度代理Tout=Tin/A+Tatt(1−1/A)，A為功率衰減比；量子低溫區必須改用模式佔據。 使用合成Tin=300 K、Tatt=4 K、A=100（20 dB）；不是晶片有效溫度。 以手算或試算表計算名義式300/100+4*(1-1/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查A=1回到300 K、A很大趨近4 K；dB需用10log10A而非20log10A。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Accumulate phase φ=2πζt for conditional frequency shift ζ; ζ is Hz, not rad/s, and phase is rad. Use Synthetic residual ζ=20 kHz and idle t=1 μs; these are not vendor values. Evaluate nominal expression 2*pi*20e3*1e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compare Ramsey phase for neighboring |0⟩ and |1⟩ states and test linearity with0.5/1 μs windows.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Teaching classical noise-temperature proxy Tout=Tin/A+Tatt(1−1/A), with power attenuation A; the quantum cold limit needs mode occupations. Use Synthetic Tin=300 K, Tatt=4 K and A=100(20 dB); this is not chip effective temperature. Evaluate nominal expression 300/100+4*(1-1/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check A=1 returns300 K and large A approaches4 K; power dB uses10log10A, not20log10A.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
